description.purpose: Describe the historical CPI grid read by Sheets and the separate multi-source inflation table.
description.limitations: Exact CSV column presence/revision policy remains maintained script-owned. BLS grid is index levels; combined columns are monthly year-over-year percent. Aggregate is optional, derived and not official. Optional source outage can omit columns; current implementation tolerates all-source failure with exit 0 despite workflow commentary. Required freshness/partial-source policy remains unresolved; declarations do not invent source availability or retained raw receipts.
